criteria.evidence: Sprint JSON `citations` (SS-1) pins the cited values. Five rows were verified from source; the rest are marked secondary or not opened. The Claret & Bloemen PHOENIX table covers TRAPPIST-1 with no clamp: `sim/stellar_surface.ail` reports `ldTeffUsed` and `ldLoggUsed`, and `sim/stellar_surface_test.ail` checks that TRAPPIST-1 gets PHOENIX at log g 5.0. The unopened rows are a small weakness.

sunholo/celestial 0.5.0 is published. `sim/ailang.toml:19` pins it, and `sim/ailang.lock` records source registry and hash sha256:d94c27d3… The package has 142 tests, with check and pkg quality at no gates (sprint JSON SS0, ac13). `tests/test_physics.gd:1215` `_star_surface_photometry` probes the law and mean against the package. I did not re-run the package tests.

`stellar_surface_test.ail` has wire, below-2.13 byte-identical and determinism tests. The sprint JSON records 539 sim tests, replay 11 identical, and strict and parity green. `mk/star-surfaces.mk` runs `stellarSurfaceVm` on the strict VM and compares it with the interpreter. The `stellar-protocol-test` target is in `ci-fast`.

`tests/test_star_surface.gd` `_flux` and `_spot_oracle` compare the NORM_GRID quadrature with a grid twice as fine (1e-3) and with the single-spot closed form (3e-6 recorded). The oracle is independent of the quadrature.

Recorded: goldens G-SS-1..3 show flux equal to e_v_lux within 0.3 % (limit 0.5 %). G-SS-4 is the centroid within 0.75 px. rig/full on d09bad78 is green with make golden, so the existing `star lux` and `sky cd/m²` lines are unchanged. I could not re-run the GPU goldens.

G-SS-5 shows the Sun with and without its surface record byte-identical. `test_star_surface.gd` `_uniforms` asserts that the Sun has `surf_on` false and `ld_quad` false. The Sun keeps the linear law (u = 0.6) in the sim and GDScript.
`test_star_surface.gd` `_colour` compares chromaticity with `Blackbody.rgb_unit_luminance` to 0.002, at rest and at D·T ahead at 0.9c. The comparison is against an independent CPU blackbody.

`stellar_surface_test.ail` checkClock measures the rate from the sim's own t_e (`emissionTimeS` and `lightAgeOf`): 4.3589 closing and 0.22942 receding, to 1e-6. `test_star_surface.gd` `_phases` shows epoch is an int, 1 s moves the weight by 1/360, and a control shows float32 cannot hold the step. It asserts only that the float32 control differs from 1.0. The sim and renderer do not apply D a second time.

Headless `_fader` only checks that the peak factor lies in (1, 2) and that the unresolved case is exactly 1. The claim 'brightest displayed texel ≤ 1.2 pre-tonemap at every stop' is covered only indirectly, by G-SS-7 (totality) and the rig golden run. No per-stop texel check was found.

G-SS-6 (corona at 1.5, 3 and 4 R against Baumbach, worst 0.6 %, limit 5 %), G-SS-7 (corona at 2 R in [0.1, 0.6] with the eye adapted to the visible peak) and G-SS-8 (corona on only while a body covers the photosphere). `_eclipse` unit-tests `covered_fraction` with closed forms: 0.25 for a body inside, and 0.3910 for equal circles one radius apart. GPU-only checks, recorded rather than re-run. 'Global k same with and without the eclipse' rests on the design (the fader is per body) and G-SS-7, with no explicit assertion.

`_eclipse` asserts H-alpha at rest is red with unit luminance, and black at D = √19 (150.6 nm) and at 0.22942 (2,860 nm). The `lineObservedNm` check values are in the package tests. The coloured-by-cmf claim rests on `h_alpha_rgb`.

The recorded bench shows Aldebaran sky GPU p50 at 4.874 ms off and 4.913 ms on, a delta of +0.039 ms (limit 0.50), on Vulkan. Host load was about 40. `make bench SCENE=bridge` p99 is not evidenced separately.

`tools/star_surface_capture.gd` and the make target exist, and Mark viewed the frames (D-111, D-114: 'the eclipses are nice'). The sprint JSON `evaluations` and `follow_ups` are empty. I found no record that the 12 frames, including the partial and total eclipse, were published to gs://…/refs/star_surfaces/after/.
`sim/ailang.lock` carries celestial 0.5.0 from the registry, `sim/vendor` is removed, and rig/full is green on d09bad78 (62 min, make test plus make golden). The fast tier was not checked by me.

`ui/telescope_view.gd` exists and Mark played it. No headless test references `TelescopeView`, so the magnification formula N, the ×2 to ×2,000 clamp and the 70 % framing are unchecked. Only the capture checks it.

`sim/stops_test.ail`: checkClosePass (F, G and K dwarfs only; not a giant, an M dwarf or Vega; 1 R_sun at 19.85°), checkFreeNavStars (α Cen A at 21.9°, Aldebaran and TRAPPIST-1 on the D-54 curve) and checkDefaultStarStops.

`stellar_surface_test.ail` checkActivity tests the quiet, active, flare-rate and no-spot cases. But the working tree has uncommitted edits to `sim/data/stellar_activity.ail`: α Cen A's cycle goes from 19.0 to 19.1 years, α Cen B's from 8.1 to 8.2, and the citations change. These change the sim's `cyclePhase` input and so the spot pattern, and no re-run is recorded. The A3 flare rate (0.525 a day) is Vida-cited and checked.

gates.gate: 2 Physics: spec check values, goldens, opened renders
gates.evidence: RS-24 and RS-25 are asserted. Goldens G-SS-1..8 are recorded as ok. Renders were opened and Mark approved (D-111, D-114). The RS-25 check lives in the sim tests; the spec check values RS-24 and RS-25 sit in the design repo (#37) and I did not confirm they are merged.

The LD laws, Baumbach, differential rotation and `lineObservedNm` are in `sunholo/celestial` 0.5.0 and published. `sim/stellar_surface.ail` imports them. `physics/star_surface.gd` mirrors them, with the `test_physics.gd` probe.
`sim/stellar_surface.ail` is pure, with no Rng stream advanced (hash only). `make strict` and `make parity` are green. `stellarSurfaceVm` is run on both the VM and the interpreter.
Phases are reduced in float64 (epoch is an int, w is a fraction). `test_star_surface.gd` `_phases` has a float32 control. The hashing is pcg3d uint, exact on CPU and GPU.
The spot salt is `mix64(seed, idKey(id), window)`. checkDeterministic and checkWindows (same bytes within a window, changes across windows) pass.

`Surface.prov` labels each field measured, inferred, assumed or chosen. The spot layout is 'chosen: seeded layout' and the cells are 'inferred: the Sun's scaled'. α Cen A's cycle is cited as 'tentative'. The inspector labels from provenance (SS4) are not done.

The sprint JSON has SS4_LANDING and D111_SHOW_MORE with `passes: false` and status 'in_progress'. The design doc is still in `design_docs/planned/r2/`, and `design_docs/implemented/r2/` has no star-surfaces report. No Archive entry, changelog fragment or inspector labels are evidenced, and `evaluations` is empty. Moving the design doc to `implemented/` and syncing the roadmap are landing steps.

summary: The sim, package, renderer and test work is strong. The sim and CPU tests check the claims against independent expected values (closed forms, a finer quadrature, an exact blackbody, √19), and the recorded GPU goldens, bench and rig/full are green. Mark accepted both rounds (D-111, D-114). The score is held below 80 by the open SS4 landing (no Archive entry, report, changelog or design-doc move), an untested telescope, and an uncommitted data edit that postdates the green rig run. This is a PASS at 77/100, conditional on committing and re-verifying the data edit and completing the landing steps.
